text:
Eli B: hey all, finalizing my setup and i can't spin up a tiny compute VM in the research sandbox. `gcloud compute instances create test-vm --zone=asia-southeast1-a` returns `PERMISSION_DENIED: Required 'compute.instances.create' permission.` also tried to list projects and billing: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy research-sandbox-2026` -> 403. on the AWS side, when i try to assume the data-sandbox role i get `AccessDenied: not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML`. who owns the sandbox org policies / SSO role mapping?

CloudInfra: hey @Eli B welcome! sandbox org policies often block region creation for cost control. pinging @DevOnboard to check org whitelist and billing groups. can you confirm your email and which sandbox project id?

Eli B: eli.b@redwood.com, project id is research-sandbox-2026. thanks.

DevOnboard: got it. two things: 1) GCP org policy blocking asia-southeast1 is controlled by infra-policy team; i'll open infra-ticket INF-4912 to request region add for the sandbox and mark it as dev-only. 2) AWS SSO mapping: sounds like your Okta groups didn't provision to the AWS account. @CloudInfra can you check SCIM?

Megan L: meg here from infra-policy. we intentionally block apac regions for shared sandboxes by default. for research-sandbox we can allow asia-southeast1 if you agree to restrict egress and to use pre-approved AMIs. Eli, do you need external network access from that VM?

Eli B: minimal external access for pulling datasets from s3, so outbound to s3 endpoints only would be fine.

CloudInfra: SCIM audit shows Eli is in okta group `researchers` but that group wasn't mapped to the AWS account `555666777888` for the `data-sandbox` role. i've triggered a group->account mapping and pushed a SCIM resync. SCIMBot will post when complete.

SCIMBot: Automated: SCIM provisioning sync completed for group research-sandboxers at 2026-03-24T09:12:08Z.

DevOnboard: Megan, i've added the infra-ticket INF-4912 with the requested constraints (apac allow + egress to s3, AMI whitelist). will set it to low-risk dev access.

Megan L: approved. i'll update the org policy to allow asia-southeast1 for project research-sandbox-2026 and add policy bindings: deny public egress and force VPC-SC if you go to prod. should be applied in ~20m.

Eli B: re-ran `gcloud compute instances create` after 30m and it succeeded. thanks! aws assume-role still failed initially though.

CloudInfra: after SCIM resync please fully logout of Okta and re-login, then retry the SSO flow. if you still see `AssumeRoleWithSAML` errors, paste the exact CLI error.

Eli B: re-login done, retried `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/DataSandboxAccess --role-session-name eli-onboard` -> worked, returned temp creds. :tada:

DevOnboard: awesome. INF-4912 closed and noted in onboarding checklist. Eli, i left links in the ticket to the sandbox AMI list and the lightweight VPC egress pattern. ping me if you need help setting up the `~/.aws/credentials` profile or a gcloud service account key for automated tests.

Eli B: will do, huge thanks everyone.
__notes: single thread string with root + replies, includes commands, bot messages, and short onboarding back-and-forth
